title: KeyboardLayout
description: Key geometry for the keyboard typo model (gameplan §8.4): which keys are physically adjacent. Rows are listed top to bottom, keys left to right in the base layer; row offsets give the stagger in key widths.
$comment: v0 (Phase 1). Interim, hand-encoded layouts until CLDR Keyboard 3.0 XML is compiled into this shape (gameplan §6.7).

source.description: Standard or reference the layout follows.
